server.title: Add a server powered by outlet group {group}
server.description:
A server plugged into outlet group {group} of the UPS at {host}. The controller shuts these servers down in an outage and then switches that group off.

Added so far: {added}.

Each server needs at least one shutdown channel: an iDRAC, a Proxmox API token, or both.

data.reach_port: TCP port that answers while the OS is up
data.add_another: Add another server after this one

error.duplicate_name: A server with this name was already added.

init.title: UPS sync settings
init.description:
Times are in seconds. The controller never cuts power until the idle load is set.

Grid entities are for a UPS fed by a battery upstream. Pick things that only work while the grid is up, such as a wall charger's voltage sensor. When none of them shows life, the servers are shut down and their group is cut even though the UPS still has input, and they are not restored until one shows life again. Leave empty to act only when the UPS itself is on battery.

data.load_idle_max: UPS output (W) at or below which the servers are certainly off
data.notify_services: Notify services, comma separated (for example notify.mobile_app_phone)
data.grid_entities: Entities that only work on grid power (optional)
data.t_ob: On battery this long before shutdown starts
data.t_grid: Grid down this long (by the entities above) before shutdown starts
data.t_grace: Wait after the last server goes quiet before cutting
data.t_dead: Wait before cutting when servers went off on their own
data.t_wake: Wait before powering on a server that is off while another is up
data.t_hold: Input stable this long before restore
data.t_wait: Alarm if shutdown takes longer than this
